findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 10 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; every question part solved step by step (ref, how to think, steps, final answer), answers verified independently with sympy and compared with the answer key and a solution book; Video Solution view shows 'Video not available yet'.

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints 13\sin(\alpha + \phi), \tan\phi = \frac{5}{12} for this part. It does not match the printed expression 24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is 24\sin\theta + 7\cos\theta = 25\sin(\theta + \phi).

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints 5\sin(\theta + \phi), \tan\phi = \frac{4}{3} for this part. It does not match the printed expression 12\sin\theta - 5\cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is 12\sin\theta - 5\cos\theta = 13\sin(\theta - \phi).

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints \sqrt{2}\sin(\theta + \phi), \tan\phi = -1 (the label (iii) itself is missing) for this part. It does not match the printed expression \sin\theta - \cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is \sin\theta - \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\sin\left(\theta - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right).

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints \sqrt{41}\sin(\theta + \phi), \tan\phi = -\frac{4}{5} for this part. It does not match the printed expression 8\sin\theta - 6\cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is 8\sin\theta - 6\cos\theta = 10\sin(\theta - \phi).

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints \sqrt{2}\sin(\theta + \phi), \tan\phi = 1 for this part. It does not match the printed expression \dfrac{1}{2}\sin\theta + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is \dfrac{1}{2}\sin\theta + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos\theta = \sin\left(\theta + \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right).

Book correction: The answer key (labelled "14.") prints \sqrt{34}\sin(\theta + \phi), \tan\phi = -\frac{5}{3} for this part. It does not match the printed expression 13\sin\theta - 84\cos\theta; the required form with \phi in quadrant I is 13\sin\theta - 84\cos\theta = 85\sin(\theta - \phi).
